service: CADC (Canadian Astronomy Data Centre) TAP service "argus" (ivo://cadc.nrc.ca/argus), CAOM-2 schema, sync endpoint
method_notes: Endpoint discovery: the legacy https://www.cadc-ccda.hia-iha.nrc-cnrc.gc.ca/tap/sync returns HTTP 404 (retired). The current service was resolved from the CADC registry with astroquery.cadc (ivo://cadc.nrc.ca/argus -> https://ws.cadc-ccda.hia-iha.nrc-cnrc.gc.ca/argus/).

Transport: queries were POSTed with curl -L; Python requests cannot follow CADC's sync->job redirect through this sandbox's egress proxy (ProxyError), and CADC requires FORMAT=votable (votable_plain is rejected).

Case-sensitivity trap (documented because it flipped the answer): CAOM-2 collection names are case-sensitive. Queries with collection='NEOSSat' return ZERO rows; the real collection is 'NEOSSAT' (773,583 observations). All first-pass NEOSSat zeros below are superseded by the corrected-case queries.

queries.label: schema_probe
queries.adql: SELECT column_name FROM TAP_SCHEMA.columns WHERE table_name='caom2.Observation' AND (column_name IN ('collection','observationID','target_name','obsID'))
queries.result: All four columns exist: collection, obsID, observationID, target_name.

queries.label: neossat_size_WRONG_CASE
queries.adql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM caom2.Observation WHERE collection='NEOSSat'
queries.result: n = 0 -- artefact of case sensitivity; superseded by neossat_size.

queries.label: neossat_size
queries.adql: SELECT collection, COUNT(*) AS n FROM caom2.Observation WHERE collection IN ('NEOSSat','NEOSSAT','NEOS','NEOSSat-1','NEOS-SAT','CSA_NEOSSat') GROUP BY collection

queries.label: neossat_field_overlap_WRONG_CASE
queries.adql: SELECT TOP 50 ... WHERE o.collection='NEOSSat' AND INTERSECTS(p.position_bounds, CIRCLE('ICRS', 167.1309, 5.1732, 0.5)) = 1
queries.result: 0 rows -- same case artefact; superseded by neossat_field_overlap_NEOSSAT.

queries.label: neossat_target_atlas_WRONG_CASE
queries.adql: SELECT observationID, target_name, intent FROM caom2.Observation WHERE collection='NEOSSat' AND (UPPER(target_name) LIKE '%ATLAS%' OR UPPER(target_name) LIKE '%3I%' OR UPPER(target_name) LIKE '%C/2025%')
queries.result: Client-side timeout at 240 s, no result returned; superseded by neossat_target_3I.

queries.label: neossat_field_overlap_NEOSSAT
queries.adql: SELECT TOP 15 o.observationID, o.target_name, o.intent, p.dataProductType, p.calibrationLevel, p.time_bounds_lower, p.time_bounds_upper FROM caom2.Observation AS o JOIN caom2.Plane AS p ON o.obsID = p.obsID WHERE o.collection='NEOSSAT' AND INTERSECTS(p.position_bounds, CIRCLE('ICRS', 167.1309, 5.1732, 0.5)) = 1
queries.result: Rows returned immediately (TOP 15 cap). Every sampled row has target_name='3I', intent='science', dataProductType='image'. Sample (8 of 15 shown):

queries.label: neossat_overlap_counts
queries.adql: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT o.observationID), MIN(p.time_bounds_lower), MAX(p.time_bounds_upper) FROM caom2.Observation o JOIN caom2.Plane p ... WHERE o.collection='NEOSSAT' AND INTERSECTS(...) = 1 [and variant with o.target_name='3I']

queries.label: neossat_target_3I
queries.adql: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT observationID) FROM caom2.Observation WHERE collection='NEOSSAT' AND target_name='3I'
queries.result: 4,417 observations in the NEOSSAT collection carry target_name='3I'. A TOP-20 sample of the ATLAS/3I/C2025 LIKE search returned target_name='3I' rows with intent science and calibration.

queries.label: control_field_overlap_all_collections
queries.adql: SELECT o.collection, COUNT(*) AS n FROM caom2.Observation o JOIN caom2.Plane p ON o.obsID=p.obsID WHERE INTERSECTS(p.position_bounds, CIRCLE('ICRS', 167.1309, 5.1732, 0.5)) = 1 GROUP BY o.collection
queries.result: The spatial method works: 18 collections cover the field, NEOSSAT among them (236 joined rows). Counts are joined observation-plane rows.

honest_conclusion: NEOSSat data at CADC is directly relevant to this project -- the opposite of the zero the first (wrong-case) queries suggested. The CSA microsatellite's archive collection is 'NEOSSAT' (773,583 observations). It contains 4,417 observations with target_name '3I', and 44 distinct '3I' observations whose footprints overlap a 0.5-deg circle around our SPHEREx field centre, taken 2025-12-13 to 2025-12-14 -- including science images on 2025-12-14 between ~07:57 and ~09:57 UTC, i.e. the same morning as, and interleaved with, our SPHEREx epochs (07:39 and 10:58 UTC). Identification of target_name '3I' with comet 3I/ATLAS rests on three independent checks that all hold: the name, footprints overlapping the comet's sky position, and timestamps during its pass. Caveats: this check is metadata-level (CAOM-2 TAP); no NEOSSat image pixels were downloaded or measured in this time-boxed pass, and overlap counts mix all historical pointings for the any-target figure (the '3I'-restricted figures are the relevant ones).
